raw_segments.text: The rigging lived. The mastheads, like the tops of tall palms, were outspreadingly tufted
with arms and legs. Clinging to a spar with one hand, some reached forth the other with
impatient wavings. Others, shading their eyes from the vivid sunlight, sat far out on the
rocking yards, all the spars in full bearing of mortals, ready and ripe for their fate.
